description: Search the Celestia Fibre history kept by Cumulo (Mocha testnet, mocha-5), live: give a transaction hash, blob id or commitment, a block height, an account (celestia1...), a namespace, a validator (name, celestiavalcons1... or celestiavaloper1...) or a UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) and get the blobs, events, validators or the daily totals that match, with the archive files of a day. Use it when you hold an identifier and do not know what it is. For the latest blobs or events without an identifier use list_fibre_blobs or list_fibre_events. Names in results are typed by validators and publishers and marked untrusted.

chain.description: Chain id; leave out for the one Cumulo monitors today (mocha-5, the Mocha testnet)

limit.description: Blobs and events to show per kind

q.description: Transaction hash, blob id, commitment, height, account, namespace, validator or a UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: search_fibre
